subject: [hw] DONE P03 (client library, transports, phone hardware back end, CLI)
body:
DONE P03. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published. Commits 1908a5a, 19c7b5e, 605fbf4 (client/** + dsh-state/workers/P03/STATUS.md only).

Acceptance:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/client/test/run_tests.sh
Last line:
  N2TEST P03 PASS 526/526
Full run (ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2, TSan -O1, then the real CLI end to end, then an arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile gate):
  checks: 171, failures: 0   N2TEST P03-TEST PASS 171/171   (x3 builds)
  n2vcd_cli info / enc / usage: 12/12
  arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile with -Werror: 1/1
  ~10 s, everything under /tmp/n2hw-P03.

Implemented (all in gpu/hwcodec/client/**):
- n2vc_hw_dev.c: n2vc_hw_open_dev() over the RWVC_* ioctls, one per method, EINTR retried, RWVC_INFO abi check; RWVC_REGS.poll_timeout_us = 1000000 (the frozen n2vc_hw.regs has no timeout argument); every failure -errno.
- n2vcd_transport.c: relay on /dev/redwood-vcodec-client (MSG_SEND/RECV, DMA_ALLOC with RWVC_DMA_SHARED, RW/FREE) and host SOCK_SEQPACKET with buffers in <socket>.buf/<decimal handle> (0600, ftruncate; -ENOSYS on iOS).
- n2vcd_server.h/.c: server side (accept/recv-from-any/send-to-client/close notice) for both transports, API- and semantics-compatible with hw-ips daemon/n2vcd_srv.h; RWVC_DMA_INFO relay path.
- n2vcd_client.h/.c: connect/HELLO, enc_open (allocates the OPEN_OK buffers), enc_frame(+_ex), enc_set, flush, close, disconnect; sequence and session checked on every reply; 5 s bounded receives; N2VCD_E_* mapping; E_GUEST/vanished server session-fatal; one mutex per client (thread-safe per session); connect_path/status_errno helpers for P04s adapter.
- n2vcd_cli.c: n2vcd_cli enc in.yuv WxH fps bitrate out.h264 [--socket|--dev], info; NV12 input, per-frame "N2VCD CLI frame N bytes=B key=K hw_us=U", summary line; exit 0 only on a complete Annex B stream, 2 on usage/input, 1 on runtime.

Evidence beyond the package (host):
- hw-ips vcodecd suite with my CLI, copy of daemon/test/run_tests.sh with OUT redirected to /tmp/n2hw-P03 (their files untouched): N2TEST IP PASS 717/717 (235/235 ASan, 235/235 -O2, 235/235 TSan, 12/12 real n2vhost). CLI log: frame 0 1577 B key, frame 1 10 B, done frames=2. So the <socket>.buf/<handle> convention and their --dma-dir interoperate.
- arm64-ios: all five sources compile with -Werror; n2vcd_cli links 69888 B NOUNDEFS. build_ios.sh currently fails at the vcodecd link on three IV-archive symbols missing from daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (_pthread_key_create, _pthread_setspecific, _strnlen; all SDK exports); with them in a throwaway TBD vcodecd links 271504 B NOUNDEFS. Reported to hw-ip; not a P03 source change.

Not done / open (full detail in gpu/hwcodec/client/STATUS.md and dsh-state/workers/P03/STATUS.md):
1. No phone run. The relay and hardware back end are verified against a recording ioctl only; the main session owns the first device test.
2. n2vc_hw.regs() has no poll-timeout parameter; 1 s/poll is a documented default (kernel max, 2 s batch budget). If VENC needs different values, the frozen header needs a field.
3. client/n2vcd_server.c duplicates daemon/n2vcd_srv.c symbol names; vcodecd must use one or the other, never both.
4. CLI is H.264 only; no decoder API (DEC_* unwrapped, daemon answers E_UNSUPPORTED); ENC_SET/FLUSH are library-only.
5. n2vcd_enc_frame requires a destination capacity >= n2vcd_session_out_bytes() (smaller is refused before sending).
6. A second OPEN after E_BUSY is not retried automatically.

I answered hw-p04 with the final API and a concrete adapter mapping (connect_path/status_errno), and hw-t02 with the CLI lines. Staying available for review findings and integration requests.
